P1.2.text: We offer personalized mental health care through in-person and online therapy or psychiatry. Our licensed therapists, psychologists, and psychiatrists tailor care plans to your unique needs—and we accept most major insurance.

P1.4.text: Get the Mental Health Help You Need, the Way You Need It

P1.31.text: US Family / Martin Point Health Plan

P1.32.text: US Family / Martin Point Health Plan-Medicare

P1.33.text: I have been a patient at LifeStance for about a year now and have only positive things to say about the care I have received.

P1.34.text: At LifeStance supported practices, there’s no one-size-fits-all approach to mental health. We tailor our care plans to fit each person’s unique needs. Our supported clinicians include psychiatrists, psychologists, and licensed therapists who are ready to support you. LifeStance supported practices offer both in-person and telehealth appointments, so you get the care you need in the format that serves you best. We also accept major insurance plans, allowing you to get the most from your personalized care plan.

P1.35.text: Get help for your specific condition

P1.36.text: Find the right clinician match for you

P1.37.text: Book an in-person or online appointment

P1.38.text: Our supported clinicians help people living with a variety of mental health conditions.

P1.39.text: Depression, bipolar disorders, or seasonal affective disorder can affect a person’s mood in a way that negatively impacts your life. Learning more about these mood disorders can help.

P1.40.text: Generalized anxiety disorder is a mental health condition characterized by a chronic and sustained worry that is intense enough to interrupt daily life.

P1.41.text: These conditions often require specialized care. We can help people cope with conditions such as avoidant, borderline, and obsessive-compulsive personality disorders.

P1.42.text: Conditions like ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and oppositional defiant disorder can impact many parts of a person’s mental health. Learn how professionals can help.

P1.44.text: Our expansive network of licensed clinicians offers a wide variety of services.

P1.45.text: We provide mental health services when and where you need it.

P2.2.text: When you refer someone to LifeStance Health, you gain a collaborative team. We are your partners in caring for your patients. We keep you informed of your patient’s treatment plan.

P2.3.text: Healthcare Professionals and LifeStance Improve Lives Together

P2.4.text: Empowering Patient Care with LifeStance Health Support

P2.5.text: Every day, healthcare professionals see patients needing mental health treatment. As a trusted member of their care team, they look to you to provide guidance on their path to well-being. LifeStance Health’s clinicians treat a broad range of conditions and are in-network with more than 240 insurance plans. In most states, patients can be scheduled for therapy and/or psychiatry services in less than one week.

P1.1.text: Home - USPh - U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc.

P1.2.text: U.S. Physical Therapy offers ownership retention and business growth for PT clinic owners.

P1.3.text: U.S. Physical Therapy has Been Supporting Private Practice Partnerships

P1.4.text: Our partnerships thrive by growing the team and business identity they have already worked hard to cultivate. Our support teams are just that – support. From staffing to marketing, development, and operations, we work hard to realize your success. Together – we’re better.

P1.6.text: YOUR PARTNER IN A SAFE, HEALTHY WORKPLACE

P1.7.text: Our View on the Partnership Opportunity

P1.8.text: We’re looking to partner with physical and occupational therapy clinic owners with pride in their clinical outcomes and respect for their patients and staff. By choosing to partner with U.S. Physical Therapy, your brand will stay in place, we’ll purchase a percentage of your business, and you will retain an ownership stake in your clinics as we continue to grow together.

P1.9.text: U.S. Physical Therapy believes in the power of private practice.

P1.10.text: Through our partnership model, our community focused clinics provide pre- and post-operative care for a variety of orthopedic-related disorders and sports-related injuries, rehabilitation of injured workers and preventative care.

P1.11.text: HEALTHY WORKFORCE AND WORKER'S COMPENSATION SERVICES

P2.1.text: Company Overview - USPh - U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc.

P2.2.text: U.S. Physical Therapy is one of the largest, pure-play operator of outpatient physical and occupational therapy clinics.

P2.4.text: U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. operates outpatient physical therapy clinics throughout the United States. The Company’s clinics provide preventative and post-operative care for a variety of orthopedic-related disorders and sports-related injuries, treatment for neurologically-related injuries, and rehabilitation of injured workers. In addition to owning and operating clinics, the Company manages multiple physical therapy facilities for unaffiliated third parties, including hospitals and physician groups. The Company also has an industrial injury prevention business which provides onsite services for clients’ employees, including injury prevention and rehabilitation, performance optimization, post-offer employment testing, functional capacity evaluations, and ergonomic assessments.

P3.1.text: Hospital and Physician Services - USPh - U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc.

P3.2.text: U.S. Physical Therapy offers tailored therapy solutions for both hospitals and physician groups in most states across the nation. Whether looking to expand with a new satellite clinic or exploring management service solutions for your therapy lines, we will work with you to help find the most effective options for your specific situation.

P3.3.text: Flexible solutions based upon your needs

P3.4.text: Vast expertise in therapy practice operations and management, including compliance and regulatory related affairs

P3.5.text: You will be contacted shortly by a member of our team to discuss your situation and how USPh can best support your organization.
